correction: Added the quotient factorization triangle V --f--> U, V --pi--> V/W, and V/W --bar f--> U in Remarks; preserved all existing bytes and appended only the illustration.

diagram_math_checks.justification: The objects V, U and V/W are exactly those in the Statement. L1 supplies the linear surjection pi:V to V/W, with pi(v)=v+W explicitly in L3 and def-quotient-vector-space-and-canonical-projection. The vertical arrow therefore has source V and target V/W.

The Statement assumes linear f:V to U and W contained in ker f. Step 1.1 uses this containment to make bar f(v+W)=f(v) well defined and linear from V/W to U. The top arrow is f:V to U; the dashed diagonal points from V/W to U. It signifies the unique induced map, not an assumed isomorphism.

For every v in V, bar f(pi(v))=bar f(v+W)=f(v), exactly as proved in step 2.1; thus the vertical-then-diagonal path and top path agree as maps V to U. Step 2.1 proves uniqueness using surjectivity of pi. No additional relation, injectivity or surjectivity of f or bar f is asserted.
The original two proof steps are byte-identical. The final Remarks explicitly identifies the triangle as an illustration of step 2.1; no proof relies on the figure.
